description: Telangana will let applicants take the learner's licence test from home on the Sarathi portal, with AI face checks by webcam and launch due within a week.
body_lead: The Telangana Transport Department will let applicants take the learner’s licence (LLR) test from home on a computer or laptop, without visiting a Regional Transport Office (RTO). The online test runs on the Centre’s Sarathi portal with AI-based facial recognition and remote monitoring, and the department is expected to launch it formally within a week, reports on 3 November 2026 said. Telangana has joined the Sarathi facility introduced by the central government and decided to adopt the new system.
